crossRefs.note: When he was alone, those who were around him with the twelve asked him about the parables.
With many such parables he spoke the word to them, as they were able to hear it.
Without a parable he didn’t speak to them; but privately to his own disciples he explained everything.

translations.web: The disciples came, and said to him, “Why do you speak to them in parables?”
translations.bsb: Then the disciples came to Jesus and asked, “Why do You speak to the people in parables?”
translations.kjv: And the disciples came, and said unto him, Why speakest thou unto them in parables?
translations.asv: And the disciples came, and said unto him, Why speakest thou unto them in parables?
